app.forecast.tip.list_act:
Action icons (hover to see the name)
✎ Open / Edit · ✓ Release (Draft → in use) · 🗑 Delete (only a Draft that was never released) · ⊘ Block (suspends the whole year, a reason is required) · 🔓 Unblock · ↺ Version history · ⧉ Copy to next year
app.forecast.tip.ws_save:
The one save button of this Configuration · saves every tab at once
Configuration + Sales Target are saved right away · with a Judgment / Adjustment a review screen opens before confirming
Switch tabs freely, edits are kept · a tab with an orange dot has unsaved edits
New Config: fill in the Configuration and the Target first, then save once
app.forecast.tip.f_pipe:
Sales line = the Pipeline (Opportunity Config) used to view and adjust figures
All pipelines = every pipeline together, Target and Forecast · Manager Adjustment is view only
One pipeline = compares the Target and the Forecast of that pipeline, and its Manager Adjustment can be edited
Example: Pimchanok adjusts +150,000 in the project-sales pipeline → +150,000 shows only when project sales is selected, and in All pipelines
app.forecast.tip.tg_pipe:
Targets are set per pipeline · choose a pipeline first, then the months, then enter the targets
Enter only the employees who sell that pipeline; a blank cell = no target for that pipeline (do not enter 0)
Team targets are per pipeline too · Overview / Dashboard can show "All pipelines", the system adds them up
Example: Somchai sells both pipelines → 2 cells · Wipa sells retail only → retail only
app.forecast.tip.pg_list:
The Configurations of the company by fiscal year (1 year = 1 Configuration in use)
Click a row or "Open" to go to Sales Forecast Configuration of that Configuration and manage its Configuration · Sales Target · Adjustment · Close Forecast Period
The highlighted row = the Configuration left open in Sales Forecast Configuration
Going to Sales Forecast Configuration directly opens the last Configuration you opened, or the released one of the current year
app.forecast.tip.list_status: StatusDraft — being set up, not used for calculation yet; can be deleted if never releasedRelease — in use for that year · one release per year at a time · saving an edit creates a new Version automaticallyBlock — no longer used, the whole year is read only · can be unblocked back to Release
app.forecast.tip.list_ver: The current Version number · goes up automatically each time an edit of a released Config is saved · click "History" to see what each Version changed
app.forecast.tip.list_copy: Creates a Draft of the next year from the values of this item; use it at the start of a new year
app.forecast.tip.pg_setup: The forecast rules per company per year, used by every Forecast screen of that year
app.forecast.tip.cfg_ver:
Edit a released Config and save → a new Version is created automatically and the previous one is kept in the history
A Draft Config is saved over the same Version
app.forecast.tip.pg_target: Sets the sales (Revenue) target per employee per month of the fiscal year of the open Configuration · set by the Executive / Configurator
app.forecast.tip.ws_switch: Switches to the Configuration of another year right away, staying in the same sub-menu
app.forecast.tip.cfg_pipe_ro: Counts the OPPs of every Opportunity-single pipeline of the company; nothing to choose
app.forecast.tip.pg_adjust: Adjusts the forecast figures without changing the original opportunity data, at 2 levelsOpportunity Judgment — per deal: IN/OUT, %, amount, categoryManager Adjustment — the total per employee
app.forecast.tip.pg_close: Close a period at the end of the month: a snapshot of the figures is kept and the Target / Judgment / Adjustment of that period are locked
app.forecast.tip.pg_overview: Summary of the saved forecast of the selected period by team, employee and category · click a row to see the opportunities behind the figure
app.forecast.tip.pg_dash: Charts for the selected time range (year / quarter / month) and team, from saved data, limited to what you are allowed to see
app.forecast.tip.pg_hist: Every change is recorded: old value → new value, who, when and why. It cannot be edited or deleted
app.forecast.tip.g_general: The basic data and the main form of this year’s forecast
app.forecast.tip.cfg_code:
Configuration code, unique within the company
Example: FC-2026
app.forecast.tip.cfg_name:
The name shown on screens and reports
Example: Sales Forecast 2026
app.forecast.tip.cfg_year:
The fiscal year this Config applies to · every period of the year is calculated by it
One release per year at a time
app.forecast.tip.cfg_period: The time unit of the forecastMonthly — targets, adjustments and closing are done month by monthQuarterly — done quarter by quarter (3 months together)
app.forecast.tip.g_calc: Decides who an opportunity is counted for, which line it rolls up along and how its value is calculated
app.forecast.tip.cfg_hier: The structure used to roll figures up from employees to managers and the company; it also decides who a figure is counted forEntity Organize Chart — rolls up along the reporting line of the organization chart · counted for the OPP owner (an employee with a position in the chart)Sale Group — rolls up by sales group · counted for the Sale Person of the OPP
app.forecast.tip.cfg_credit:
Set automatically from the roll-up structure; nothing to choose
Entity Organize Chart → the OPP owner
Sale Group → the Sale Person
app.forecast.tip.cfg_formula: How the value of an open OPP is calculated (Closed Success counts in full, Close Loss is not counted)Weighted — amount × %, e.g. 1,000,000 × 80% = 800,000Full Amount — the full amount, 1,000,000
app.forecast.tip.cfg_overdue: How an OPP that is still open after its target month is counted · a closed OPP (Sold / Lost) always counts in the period it was really closed, whatever is chosen hereShow as Overdue — not counted in the forecast until closed, but shown in the current period with an Overdue tag so it can be followed upCount in the current period — counted as forecast of the current period until closedDo not count — left out of the forecast and not shown until closed
app.forecast.tip.g_adj: What can be adjusted in the forecast · when switched off, the related fields of the Adjustment page are locked
app.forecast.tip.cfg_judg:
On: managers can set IN/OUT and override the % / amount per OPP
Off: the Opportunity Judgment table is read only
app.forecast.tip.cfg_catovr:
On: the category of an OPP can be moved in the forecast only, e.g. Best Case → Committed
The category on the real OPP does not change
app.forecast.tip.cfg_mgr: On: managers can adjust the total (Δ) per employee in the Manager Adjustment tab
app.forecast.tip.g_ro: Values that come from the company data or the Opportunity Config; they cannot be changed here
app.forecast.tip.cfg_src: The forecast reads values from opportunities only; it is not linked to Sales Orders or Invoices
app.forecast.tip.cfg_meas: Measured as value (Revenue) in the company currency
app.forecast.tip.cfg_fy: The first month of the fiscal year, read from the company data; it defines the quarters and the year
app.forecast.tip.cfg_cur: The company currency; every figure is shown in it
app.forecast.tip.cfg_map: The % and the category of each Activity Step are set in the Opportunity Config · an OPP takes the values of the step it is in
app.forecast.tip.tg_year:
Choose the fiscal year to set targets for · 1 year = 1 Configuration
Example: to set next year’s targets in advance → choose next year (a Draft Config works too; it takes effect on Release)
If the year is not in the list → create its Configuration in Sales Forecast Listing first (or click ⧉ Copy to next year)
Changing the year here switches the Configuration of the whole page (like the dropdown above)
app.forecast.tip.tg_pick: Click the months you want (several can be chosen) · click a quarter heading to select / clear its 3 months · 🔒 = closed period
app.forecast.tip.tg_sel: The selected months become the columns / rows of the table below · click × to remove one
app.forecast.tip.tg_td: Enter the target per employee per month; one save stores every selected month
app.forecast.tip.tg_team: Team target (optional) · if the members do not add up to it the system warns "over / short" but does not block
app.forecast.tip.tg_emp: The target of the employee in that month (baht); must be 0 or more
app.forecast.tip.tg_sum: The total target of all selected months
app.forecast.tip.f_month: The period (month) of the forecast · a closed period can be viewed but not edited
app.forecast.tip.f_team: Filter by team · only the teams you are allowed to see
app.forecast.tip.f_emp: Filter by employee · the summary follows this filter
app.forecast.tip.adj_sum: The figures change while you edit (Preview) · they only take effect after "Review and save"
app.forecast.tip.adj_base: The figure the system calculates from the opportunities by the formula of the Configuration, before any adjustment
app.forecast.tip.adj_judg: The difference made by the per-OPP adjustments (IN/OUT, %, amount, category)
app.forecast.tip.adj_mgr: The sum of the Δ managers adjusted per employee
app.forecast.tip.adj_final: Final = before adjustment + Judgment effect + Manager Adjustment · used in Overview and Dashboard
app.forecast.tip.adj_cat: Figures by category before and after Judgment · Omitted = value that is not counted (Close Loss or OUT)
app.forecast.tip.j_tab: Per-deal adjustments for the forecast of this period · the original values are read from the opportunity and are not changed · Closed / Omitted are read only
app.forecast.tip.j_sel: Select several deals, then click "OUT selected" / "IN selected"
app.forecast.tip.j_catorig: The category and the step of the current Activity Step of the OPP
app.forecast.tip.j_porig: The closing probability % of the current Activity Step
app.forecast.tip.j_aorig: The deal amount on the OPP
app.forecast.tip.j_in: IN — count this deal in the forecastOUT — do not count (the value goes to Omitted) · the OPP status does not change
app.forecast.tip.j_fcat: Moves the category in the forecast only, e.g. sure a Best Case deal will close → choose Committed
app.forecast.tip.j_fprob: The % used in the calculation (0–100) · applies when the formula is Weighted
app.forecast.tip.j_famt: The amount used in the calculation (0 or more) · the amount on the OPP is not changed
app.forecast.tip.j_val: The value counted in the forecast: before (struck through) → after, and the difference
app.forecast.tip.j_reason:
Required when any value of the row changes · recorded in the History
Example: the customer extended the scope
app.forecast.tip.m_tab: Adjusts the total per employee per sales line (Pipeline), kept as a difference (Δ) apart from the system figure · choose a pipeline in the filter before adjusting · when an OPP changes the figure before adjustment is recalculated but the Δ stays · team figure = sum of its members
app.forecast.tip.m_base: The system figure from the OPPs before adjustment
app.forecast.tip.m_judged: The figure after the per-OPP adjustments (Judgment)
app.forecast.tip.m_jd: The difference made by Judgment · click "View" to go to the deals of this employee
app.forecast.tip.m_delta: Two ways to enterLeft box (Δ) — the difference to add / subtract, e.g. +150,000 or −50,000Right box (set Final) — type the Final you want; the system works out the Δ
app.forecast.tip.m_final: Final of the employee = after Judgment + Δ
app.forecast.tip.m_gap: Final − Target · negative = still below target
app.forecast.tip.m_reason: Required when Δ ≠ 0 · recorded in the History
app.forecast.tip.cl_status: Open — Target / Judgment / Adjustment can be editedClosed — read only · only the System Configurator can reopen it, with a reason
app.forecast.tip.cl_snap: The Final kept at the moment the period was closed
app.forecast.tip.cl_live: The Final now, from the saved values
app.forecast.tip.ov_tgt: The total target of this period
app.forecast.tip.ov_won: The value of the OPPs closed successfully = actual sales
app.forecast.tip.ov_open: The full amount of the OPPs that are still open and counted (IN)
app.forecast.tip.ov_gap: Final − Target · negative = the target is expected to be missed
app.forecast.tip.ov_cat: Figures by forecast category, by the formula of the Config
app.forecast.tip.ov_tbl: Team → employee · click a row to see the deals below
app.forecast.tip.ov_deals: The opportunities behind the figure of the clicked row · "Adjusted" = it has a Judgment
app.forecast.tip.sc_box: Three possible outcomes, using the full deal amount (not weighted by %) and only the deals that are IN
app.forecast.tip.sc_min: Closed + Committed · the fairly certain figure, if every Committed deal closes
app.forecast.tip.sc_final: The Final Forecast after adjustment · the main forecast figure
app.forecast.tip.sc_max: Closed + Committed + Best Case · the highest possible figure, if the Best Case deals close too
app.forecast.tip.db_type: Time levelYear — the 12 months of the selected yearQuarter — 3 months togetherMonth — one month only
app.forecast.tip.db_q: The quarter of the selected year
app.forecast.tip.db_m: The month of the selected year
app.forecast.tip.db_outlook: The Target, Final and Closed Success lines per month (at month level the 3 months of that quarter are shown)
app.forecast.tip.db_team: Bar = Final of the team · green line = team Target
app.forecast.tip.db_health: Share of the figure by category · Omitted is listed but not counted in the ring
app.forecast.tip.db_bridge: How the figure moves from before adjustment → Judgment → Manager Adjustment → Final
app.forecast.tip.hi_type: Filter by the type of change

app.settings.role.title: Roles & permissions
app.settings.role.intro.title: How permissions work
app.settings.role.intro.sub: A user can work on a document after passing all 4 layers · a Role sets layers 1, 2 and 4
app.settings.role.layer.1: Module|Can they open the menu|Set in the Role · MODULE_* / AI_ACCESS_USE
app.settings.role.layer.2: Action|Which buttons can they press|Set in the Role · Pipeline_* / Chat_* / Dashboard_* / AI_*
app.settings.role.layer.3: Is it their document|Owner · superior · shared with · Wait List · View_All|Org chart + sharing · no permission to tick
app.settings.role.layer.4: Confidential data|Do they see the real value · without the right it shows ***|Set in the sensitive-data Roles (*_Data) + company settings
app.settings.role.rule.1: Permissions always add up, nothing is forbidden · a position with several Roles, or a person with several positions, gets all of them; to take a right away, take the Role away
app.settings.role.rule.2: There is no "see the team" permission · a superior sees the work of their team through the org chart, with View of that kind of document
app.settings.role.rule.3: Owner-level actions (change owner, share, close a deal, send back a step, move a chat) belong to the current owner or their superior
app.settings.role.rule.4: Managing the permissions of a Role · click a Role row to open its permissions under it, then tick Yes / No — saved at once
app.settings.role.rule.5: Can receive work · a position with View + Edit of a kind of document can be chosen as owner of it (the minimum set of a receiver)
app.settings.role.rule.6: Standard Roles are small blocks, one job each · link Roles to positions on the "Positions ↔ Roles" tab, which has example positions to start from
